definitions.explanation: To remove clothing or footwear from one's body.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。
コートを{脱|ぬ}ぎましょうか？
examples.english: Shall I take off my coat?

examples.japanese: {帽子|ぼうし}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。

notes: A godan verb ending in ぐ. Te-form is {脱|ぬ}いで. Used for all types of clothing and footwear. Opposite: {着|き}る (kiru, upper body), はく (pants/shoes), かぶる (hats).
